verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a built-in AI assistant inside GA4 that users can hand tasks to. The marketing page mentions 'Google's machine learning' insights, and one community comment mentions plain-text query 'insights'. Neither describes an in-product assistant that takes delegated tasks. The official MCP server lets external agents connect to GA, which is a separate capability, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
